description: This file contains platform-specific shell functions for checking, upgrading, and copying configuration for different hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the firmware image based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade procedure based on the hardware board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration specific to certain boards.
